hypotheses.title: Contract locks Ether without a withdraw function
hypotheses.description: It appears that the contract includes a payable function to accept Ether but lacks a corresponding function to withdraw it, which leads to the Ether being locked in the contract. To resolve this issue, please implement a public or external function that allows for the withdrawal of Ether from the contract. Instances: src/ERC7575VaultUpgradeable.sol:65, src/ShareTokenUpgradeable.sol:69

hypotheses.title: Reentrancy: State change after external call
hypotheses.description: Changing state after an external call can lead to re-entrancy attacks.Use the checks-effects-interactions pattern to avoid this issue. Instances: src/ERC7575VaultUpgradeable.sol:160, src/ERC7575VaultUpgradeable.sol:169, src/ERC7575VaultUpgradeable.sol:344

hypotheses.title: Contract Name Reused in Different Files

hypotheses.title: PUSH0 Opcode
hypotheses.description: Solc compiler version 0.8.20 switches the default target EVM version to Shanghai, which means that the generated bytecode will include PUSH0 opcodes. Be sure to select the appropriate EVM version in case you intend to deploy on a chain other than mainnet like L2 chains that may not support PUSH0, otherwise deployment of your contracts will fail. Instances: src/DecimalConstants.sol:2, src/ERC20Faucet.sol:2, src/ERC20Faucet6.sol:2

hypotheses.title: Loop Contains `require`/`revert`
